The '''HD 5-D Booster''' was an experimental [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] booster.

==Characteristics==
An unstable device, the HD 5-D booster forcibly increased a given hyperdrive's speed by shunting more energy through the engine than would normally be allowed by safeties through use of a compressor. While this was safe in theory (the booster was supposed to moderate engine output), in practice there was a very real chance of overload and serious system failure due to the energies involved.<ref name="GFT" /> In general, the HD 5-D could not be installed on [[Starship/Legends|starships]] with greater than a 100 metric ton cargo capacity, and once installed could not be un-installed and transferred to a different hyperdrive.<ref name="GFT" />
